## SUB · Get order
Lesson 4.5. The get_order tool. Inputs: chat_id (mapped from the trigger by the agent workflow, never from the model) and order_id (optional, from the model). Reads only this chat's orders; an order number from another customer gets the same "no order" answer as a missing one.

**Credential:** Google Sheets OAuth2.
**Replace:** YOUR_SHEET_ID.
Orders columns: order_id, chat_id, items_json, subtotal, delivery_fee, total, delivery_date, area, status, created_at, rider, refunded, paystack_ref.
